observations.reason: FC-04 requires real transport-level ACK loss, not a magic flag. The current DBOS Go candidate has no wired-in external provider; the harness passes `ackLost: true` to the Go binary's HTTP body, which the Go binary maps to UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_STATE in its custom SQLite — but no provider was actually called, no provider commitment occurred, and no transport ACK was dropped. Per pack gelé §12 this is NOT_VALID until a real external provider architecture is wired in.

(6) Candidate's recovery path resolves to UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_STATE. (7) Cross-verify the provider's journal contains the effectKey.
